description: This file defines the interface for an HTTP parser, including structures, enums, callback types, and function prototypes used for parsing HTTP requests and responses within the Zephyr project.

methods.name: http_parser_version
methods.description: Returns the version of the HTTP parser library.

methods.name: http_parser_init
methods.description: Initializes an http_parser structure for a specific type (request or response).

methods.name: http_parser_settings_init
methods.description: Initializes an http_parser_settings structure to default values.

methods.name: http_parser_execute
methods.description: Executes the parser on given data, returning the number of bytes parsed.

methods.name: http_should_keep_alive
methods.description: Determines if the connection should be kept alive based on the parser state.

methods.name: http_body_is_final
methods.description: Checks if the current chunk of the body is the final one.
